from collections import deque

def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); bg=grid[0][0]
    seen=set(); out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h):
      for c in range(w):
        if grid[r][c]!=bg or (r,c) in seen: continue
        q=deque([(r,c)]); seen.add((r,c)); comp=[]; edge=False; border=set()
        while q:
          y,x=q.popleft(); comp.append((y,x)); edge |= y in (0,h-1) or x in (0,w-1)
          for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
            yy,xx=y+dy,x+dx
            if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w:
              v=grid[yy][xx]
              if v==bg:
                if (yy,xx) not in seen: seen.add((yy,xx)); q.append((yy,xx))
              else: border.add(v)
        if not edge:
          fill=2 if border=={6} else 7
          for y,x in comp: out[y][x]=fill
    return out
